assets: Globe frames and native destination thumbnails were extracted from the user-supplied video. The 256px globe frames preserve the native recording at 30 fps and are encoded losslessly without upscaling or image enhancement. The looping animation uses the full-sized rotation at 1.3–4.6 seconds, excluding the video's one-time introductory shrinking animation. The still preserves the original full-sized first frame.

restoredLandscape.reference: The original 720×720 video frame at approximately 15 seconds
restoredLandscape.purpose: Extract the inner 16:9 landscape, remove burned-in navbar/title/booking UI, preserve the visible spires, foliage, camera framing and teal/golden palette, and reconstruct occluded terrain detail.
restoredLandscape.limits: Reconstructed details are synthetic; this is a reference-guided restoration, not recovered original high-resolution photography. The native scene and thumbnails remain available as alternatives through the destinations prop.
